title: get_symbols_at input
description: The innermost symbol whose declaration span holds each of 1 to 100 locations path:line (or path:line:column, the column ignored), in every tier: the symbol with its id, stable_key, kind, lines and the tier that declared it, or the file's module when no inner symbol holds the line. A location the call cannot answer has its own error or reason; the others are still answered. Lean rows: the location, then the symbol as name path:line kind, or - and the reason.

repository_id.description: Optional when exactly one repository is registered.

snapshot_id.description: Null pins the current published snapshot.

locations.description: Locations as path:line or path:line:column, path being repository-relative (an absolute path inside the repository and .. are normalised; one outside it is answered not found for that location). At most 100 per call.

freshness.description: snapshot (default) answers from the published snapshot. strict first checks that the working tree is exactly what the snapshot was built from; if not, it starts an index and refuses with STALE_INPUT naming the changed files.

envelope.description: lean, the default over MCP: plain text with no JSON and no structuredContent. A header `# <tool> · <n> rows · <snapshot> current` (stale when the snapshot is older than the repository's current one), one `<name> <path>:<line>` row per result, then `# ` lines for the limitations of this answer and `# more: cursor <c>` when a next page exists. The line is the call, import or reference site for relationship, impact and path rows and the declaration for symbol rows; tags follow: in or out when both directions are asked, depth=<n>, dispatch, external, candidate, ambiguous, unresolved:<reason>, and the relationship type when the query mixes types. A name or path with a space, quote or # is quoted as JSON. compact: the JSON envelope without the snapshot-wide parts an earlier answer gave (coverage, unresolved reasons, standing limitations). full: the whole JSON envelope. Ask for compact or full for ids, evidence and totals.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. It continues the same query on the same snapshot; it expires after an hour.
